# temporal_nexus_endpoint (Resource)

Temporal Nexus Endpoint resource. An endpoint routes Nexus requests either to a task queue in a namespace or to an external URL. Exactly one of `worker_target` and `external_target` must be set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Route Nexus requests to a task queue polled by Nexus workers
resource "temporal_nexus_endpoint" "example_worker" {
  name        = "example-worker"
  description = "Operations handled by workers in the default namespace"

  worker_target = {
    namespace  = "default"
    task_queue = "example-nexus-queue"
  }
}

# Route Nexus requests to an external Nexus server
resource "temporal_nexus_endpoint" "example_external" {
  name = "example-external"

  external_target = {
    url = "https://nexus.example.com/services"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Endpoint name, unique within the cluster. Must start with a letter, end with a letter or a digit, and contain only letters, digits and hyphens. The endpoint is renamed in place, which breaks callers that reference the old name

### Optional

- `description` (String) Endpoint description in Markdown
- `external_target` (Attributes) Route requests to an external Nexus server (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--external_target))
- `worker_target` (Attributes) Route requests to a task queue polled by Nexus workers (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--worker_target))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-generated endpoint identifier
- `url_prefix` (String) Server URL path prefix for invoking operations on this endpoint. It does not change when the endpoint is renamed
- `version` (Number) Data version of the endpoint, incremented by the server on every update. Updates fail when the endpoint was changed outside Terraform after the last refresh

<a id="nestedatt--external_target"></a>
### Nested Schema for `external_target`

Required:

- `url` (String) URL to call, with the `http` or `https` scheme


<a id="nestedatt--worker_target"></a>
### Nested Schema for `worker_target`

Required:

- `namespace` (String) Namespace to route requests to. It must exist, and it cannot be deleted while the endpoint targets it
- `task_queue` (String) Nexus task queue to route requests to

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A Nexus endpoint can be imported by specifying its ID
terraform import temporal_nexus_endpoint.example_worker 0ac9f14a-3fb8-4526-90be-854c798f9582

# A Nexus endpoint can also be imported by specifying its name
terraform import temporal_nexus_endpoint.example_worker example-worker
```
